disclaimer: This guide is general education about men's sexual health and wellbeing. It is not medical advice and does not replace diagnosis or treatment by a qualified professional. Stop any exercise that causes pain. See a doctor about sudden or persistent problems, pain, blood in urine or semen, or if you have diabetes, high blood pressure or heart disease. Emergencies (including an erection lasting more than 4 hours or chest pain): call 112. Free mental-health support in India: Tele-MANAS 14416. This guide never recommends supplements.
